items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t really meet Richie until he joined, I think Max Roach’s band something like that but I didn’t really . . . I think I met him later on when I went to hear Max’s band

ctx.x: What about Bud’s younger brother Richie?

I didn’t really meet Richie until he joined, I think Max Roach’s band something like that but I didn’t really . . . I think I met him later on when I went to hear Max’s band because Sonny Rollins had a gig with Max too, and then I think I met Max around that time and you know, it gets to be a little bit . . . I’m trying to remember it all.
You were sixteen when you met Max. Sixteen or so when you met Max.
